sentences.text:
Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary For the Petitioner : Mr. A.K.
Sahani, Advocate For the State : Mr. Santosh Kr. Shukla, A.P.P.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner named above has moved
this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Basia P.S. Case No. 51 of 2023 registered
under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla.
As per the F.I.R, a welfare committee was constituted for construction of boundary wall over Sarna sthal in which the informant was the Secretary-cum- Beneficiary.

Work was entrusted to the committee and the accused persons including this petitioner induced secretary of the committee to deposit a sum of Rs. 21,70,600/- in the HDFC bank account in the name of the committee.
It is alleged that a total sum of Rs. 21,70,600/- was withdrawn in piecemeal in the name of Praveen Kumar Sahu.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that supply of materials of Rs. 7,79,000/-
was paid.

The learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and matters involves the embezzlements of government fund of Rs. 7,00,000/- which was drawn by this petitioner.

sentences.text: Considering the nature of allegation and facts, I do not find any merit in this anticipatory bail application.

Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner, is hereby rejected and petitioner is directed to surrender before the Trail Court within two weeks from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Pawan/-
